item.description:
Postern now updates itself.
- **Check for Updates** in the Postern menu and in the menu bar icon's menu. When a version is waiting, both items name it. - **Automatic checks only if you say yes.** Postern asks once, over its window; Security › Updates changes it later. Once a day, it reads the list of versions on getpostern.vercel.app and downloads updates from GitHub. - **Signed end to end.** The list of versions and every update are signed with Postern's own key (EdDSA), checked before anything is opened, and nothing installs until you click Install and Relaunch. - **The only connection besides Bridge**, now named in the threat model with what it reveals: your IP address and Postern's version, nothing else.
